verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email-inbox API and infrastructure service for agents, not an agent or host that runs tools, so consuming third-party MCP servers is outside its product role. The evidence only shows AgentMail acting as an MCP server, through its hosted endpoint exposing inbox, message and thread tools. That is the server role and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
